apps.name: All Prototypes (landing + every demo)
apps.notes: Serves the repo root so the landing page, every prototype, and the shared toolbar in shared/ all work. Prefer this when you want the home/back button. Zero-dependency alternative: ./serve.sh

apps.name: Sim Builder Latest In Progress
apps.notes: Also works via file:// — double-click sim-builder-latest-in-progress/index.html. Serve is optional (e.g. for Figma capture).

apps.name: Clyde & Co Eligibility Quiz
apps.notes: Needs HTTP because the prototype uses ES modules; do not open with file://.

apps.name: Student sign-up
apps.notes: Works via file:// — double-click student-signup/index.html. Serve is optional.

apps.name: AI Task types
apps.notes: Versions: text-input/ (formerly the ai-feedback prototype), audio/, video/, file-upload/, email-redlining/, email-compose/, inline-redlining/, chat-recording/, video-chat/, video-call/, and chat-thread-feedback/ (canonical chat). ai-simulations/index.html redirects to text-input/; switch versions from the toolbar dropdown. Needs HTTP for the switcher to resolve ../../shared/.
